dialogue.text: Hi!! Oh my god, I thought you were never going to open that door. Do you want to play games with me?
Oh, yea that was scary… the ground was shaking like crazy, and all the buildings fell, and went like “BOOOM”

options.text: No I mean, are you hurt?

dialogue.text: Mmmh, no. I have just been looking for someone to play catch with me. Everyone is hiding away and leaving all these toys for me!
*Goes into his pockets and pulls out his toys*
Hehe… I’ve been using it to find toys. Nothing's going to stop me from having a fun time!

options.text: Say kid. Have you played menko?

dialogue.text: Yes! I play it with my friends all the time! I’m really good.

options.text: If you win, you'll get my last candies?
